## annotate

`@datars/std/annotate` — A callout: text offset from a point (in plot coordinates via scales, or px), with a connector and a dot. On a line's point it moves with the line in transitions. Keyed (`annotate({…}, { key: "note" })`), one note carries across steps: from point to point along the line it sits on.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `connector` | enum | `"line"` |  |
| `dot` | bool | `true` |  |
| `dx` | number | `40` |  |
| `dy` | number | `-36` |  |
| `head` | bool | `false` | An arrowhead at the point. |
| `ink` | ink | `"$ink"` |  |
| `pin` | bool | `false` | Pinned at the point: dot, connector and text keep screen size under cameras (map callouts). |
| `text` | string | `""` |  |
| `width` | number | `160` |  |
| `x` | prop |  | x position (expression, e.g. scale.x('SD')) |
| `y` | prop |  |  |

Theme tokens: `ink`, `paper`, `size.label`

## arcDiagram

`@datars/std/arcDiagram` — Nodes on a line and each link as an arc above it, as tall as it is long. Ordered so clusters sit together (or by degree, a field, or input order); names under the line, turned when they crowd. Links between nodes of one colour take it.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | field |  | Colour nodes (and the arcs within one colour) by this field; `community` colours clusters. Default: one colour. |
| `format` | string | `",.0f"` | Number format of sizes and weights in tooltips. |
| `id` | field |  | The nodes' id column (default `id`). |
| `label` | field |  | Node name column (default: the id). |
| `labels` | bool | `true` | Node names under the line (turned upright when they don't fit across). |
| `links` | table |  | One row per link: the ids of its two nodes (and optionally a weight). |
| `maxRadius` | number | `7` | Radius of the largest node (px). |
| `nodes` | table |  | One row per node. |
| `order` | string | `"cluster"` | Order along the line: `cluster` (communities together, best connected first), `degree`, `input`, or a column of the nodes table. |
| `selected` | string |  | A keyset signal of node ids: their arcs stay strong, the rest recede. |
| `size` | field |  | Node size field (default `degree`, the node's links). |
| `source` | field |  | The links' source column (default `source`). |
| `target` | field |  | The links' target column (default `target`). |
| `weight` | field |  | Link weight: heavier links are thicker (default: all equal). |

Theme tokens: `mark`, `categorical`, `paper`, `rule`, `ink-2`, `size.label`

## attribution

`@datars/std/attribution` — The data credit a map owes (OpenStreetMap's licence requires it), in the bottom-right corner of its box, legible and linked to the licence page (hosts make it a real link; SVG/PDF keep it). Place it outside the map's view so it stays put while the camera moves.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ink` | ink | `"$map.label"` |  |
| `link` | string | `"https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright"` | Where the credit links (OpenStreetMap's copyright page, as its guidelines ask). |
| `text` | string | `"© OpenStreetMap contributors, Natural Earth"` |  |

Theme tokens: `map.label`, `map.label-halo`

## axis

`@datars/std/axis` — An axis for a scale: tick labels, tick marks and a domain line. Labels never pile up: a horizontal numeric axis asks for as many ticks as its measured labels fit; category names wrap in their band, turn 45° when a word is wider than the band, and leave out every k-th name only when even that doesn't fit.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | table |  | The table a band scale's categories come from (with `field`): their names are measured, so a horizontal axis wraps, turns or leaves out labels only as they need. |
| `field` | field |  | The categories' field in `data`. |
| `format` | string |  | Number format for labels (d3-format). |
| `label` | string |  | Axis title: under the end of a horizontal axis; above the top of a vertical one, over its labels (a plot draws `yLabel` above its top-left corner instead, in a row of its own). |
| `line` | bool | `true` | Draw the domain line. |
| `orient` | enum | `"left"` |  |
| `prefix` | string |  | Before each number label ('$'). |
| `scale` | string | `"y"` | The scale to draw. |
| `suffix` | string |  | After it ('M', ' kr'). |
| `ticks` | number | `0` | Tick count hint (0 = automatic: from the axis length, and across, from how many of its measured labels fit). |
| `type` | string |  | The scale's type (`linear`, `log`, `time`, …; the plot passes it). A horizontal numeric axis fits its tick count to its labels' measured width. |

Theme tokens: `muted`, `rule`, `size.label`

## basemap

`@datars/std/basemap` — A basemap from a vector-tile source (our own OSM / Natural Earth archives): sea, land, water, parks, buildings, roads by class, borders and place labels, in the enclosing map's projection, styled by the theme's map tokens. Put it first inside a view with a `geo` coordinate system; data layers go after it (or between `part: base` and `part: labels`).

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `boundaries` | bool | `true` | Country borders. |
| `buildings` | bool | `true` |  |
| `labels` | bool | `true` | Place names (screen-space placement, no overlaps). |
| `layers` | json |  | Archive layer names, if they differ from the defaults: { land, water, lakes, parks, rivers, buildings, roads, boundaries, places }. |
| `part` | enum | `"all"` | Split the map around data layers: `base` below them, `labels` above. |
| `roads` | bool | `true` |  |
| `sea` | bool | `true` | Fill the world behind the land with $map.water. |
| `source` | table |  | A `tiles` source (data.tiles(url)). |
| `tileSize` | number | `512` | On-screen tile size the zoom aims for (px). Smaller: more detail, more tiles. |

## bollinger

`@datars/std/bollinger` — Bollinger bands: the moving average of `y` over `window` rows with a shaded band `k` standard deviations (population σ) above and below it — where the price is stretched, and how volatile it is. Computes over `source` when given, like `movingAverage`; the plot fits its value axis to the band.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | table |  | The rows to draw (default: the plot's). |
| `fill` | ink | `"$accent"` | Band ink. |
| `full` | bool | `true` | Only full windows. |
| `k` | number | `2` | Band half-width in standard deviations. |
| `label` | string |  | Name in the indicator key (default `BB 20, 2`). |
| `middle` | bool | `true` | Draw the middle (moving average) line. |
| `opacity` | number | `0.1` | Band opacity. |
| `series` | field |  | One band per series. |
| `source` | table |  | A longer history to compute over (see movingAverage). |
| `stroke` | ink | `"$accent"` | Ink of the band's edges and middle line. |
| `width` | number | `1` | Edge stroke width. |
| `window` | number | `20` | Rows per window. |
| `x` | field |  | The date field. |
| `xType` | string | `"band"` | `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value. |
| `y` | field |  | The field (default: the plot's `y`). |

Theme tokens: `accent`

## boxplot

`@datars/std/boxplot` — A box plot per category: the box spans the middle half (first to third quartile) with a line at the median; whiskers reach the furthest values within 1.5 × the box's height (`whisker`) of it, and values beyond are drawn as outliers. Horizontal when y is the band axis.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | field |  | Field on the colour scale (inside a plot: its colour). |
| `data` | table |  | One row per observation. |
| `fill` | prop |  | Box ink (default: the colour scale, else $mark). |
| `format` | string | `",.1~f"` | Number format in tooltips. |
| `label` | prop |  | Box label (tooltip, accessible name); default the five numbers and the count. |
| `outliers` | bool | `true` | Draw the values beyond the whiskers. |
| `whisker` | number | `1.5` | How far whiskers reach, in interquartile ranges beyond the box (Tukey's 1.5). |
| `width` | number | `0.7` | Box width as a fraction of the band (at most 72 px). |
| `x` | field |  | Field on the x axis (inside a plot: its x). |
| `xType` | string | `"band"` | The x scale's type (the plot passes it): `band`/`point` for categories, `linear`, `time`, … |
| `y` | field |  | Field on the y axis (inside a plot: its y). |
| `yType` | string | `"linear"` | The y scale's type (the plot passes it); a band y lays the chart on its side. |

Theme tokens: `mark`, `ink-2`, `paper`

## bullet

`@datars/std/bullet` — Bullet graphs: per row the actual value as a bar over qualitative bands (poor, fair, good — darkest first) with the target as a tick across it, each on its own scale with its own ticks (or one scale for all with `shared`). A compact replacement for a gauge: many measures in the height of one.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bands` | json |  | The qualitative ranges' upper bounds, ascending: field names (each row its own, `["poor", "fair", "good"]`) or numbers (the same for every row, `[150, 225, 300]`). |
| `data` | table |  | One row per measure. |
| `format` | string | `",.4~r"` | Tick and label number format. |
| `ink` | ink | `"$mark"` | The value bar's ink. |
| `label` | field |  | The measure's name (and the rows' order). |
| `max` | prop |  | Where the scale ends (a number): default each row's largest value, target or band (rounded up to a nice number without bands). |
| `shared` | bool | `false` | One scale for every row (the largest of them all), ticked under the last: measures in the same unit compare across rows. |
| `sublabel` | field |  | A second, smaller line under the name (its unit: `US$, thousands`). |
| `target` | field |  | The target (optional): a tick across the bar. |
| `value` | field |  | The actual value. |

Theme tokens: `mark`, `ink`, `ink-2`, `muted`, `size.body`, `size.small`

## bump

`@datars/std/bump` — A bump chart: each series' rank at every time, 1 at the top, joined by lines and named at both ends. Ranks come from the values at each time (largest first) or from a rank field; rows are long (series, time, value).

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | table |  | One row per (series, time). |
| `format` | string | `",.4~g"` | Number format of values in tooltips. |
| `highlight` | json |  | Series to pick out (a name or a list): they keep their colour and draw on top, the others turn grey. |
| `labelSpace` | number | `140` | Most room (px) the names take at each side. |
| `r` | number | `4.5` | Dot radius at each time (px). |
| `rank` | bool | `false` | `y` already holds ranks (1 = top). |
| `reverse` | bool | `false` | The smallest value ranks first (times, prices). |
| `series` | field |  | One line per value of this field. |
| `subtitle` | string |  | A line under the title. |
| `title` | string |  | A title above the chart. |
| `width` | number | `3` | Line width (px). |
| `x` | field |  | The time field (in order: it's sorted). |
| `y` | field |  | The value ranked at each time (or the rank itself, with `rank`). |

Theme tokens: `ink`, `ink-2`, `muted`, `grid`, `rule`, `paper`, `size.label`, `size.title`, `font.title`

## candlestick

`@datars/std/candlestick` — Candlesticks: per row a wick from low to high and a body from open to close, in `$up` when the close is at or above the open and `$down` below. Use in a plot with `xType: "band"` over dates for trading days without gaps; the plot fits its value axis to the lows and highs. Hovering a candle reads its date, OHLC and change.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `close` | field |  | Closing price field (default: the plot's `y`, else `close`). |
| `data` | table |  | The rows to draw (default: the plot's). |
| `down` | ink | `"$down"` | Ink of falling candles. |
| `format` | string | `",.2f"` | Price format in labels. |
| `high` | string | `"high"` | High field. |
| `hollow` | bool | `false` | Hollow candles: rising bodies outlined, falling ones filled. |
| `label` | prop |  | Candle label (tooltip, accessible name); default date · O H L C (change). |
| `low` | string | `"low"` | Low field. |
| `open` | string | `"open"` | Opening price field. |
| `up` | ink | `"$up"` | Ink of rising candles. |
| `width` | number | `0` | Body width: a fraction of the band on a band scale (0 = the band, whose padding leaves the gaps), px on a continuous scale (0 = 70% of the spacing). |
| `x` | field |  | The date (or time) field. |
| `xType` | string | `"band"` | `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value. |
| `y` | field |  | The plot's value field: the close, unless `close` is given. |

Theme tokens: `up`, `down`, `paper`

## card

`@datars/std/card` — A text card over the chart: an optional kicker and title over wrapped body text, on the theme's card surface, anchored to a corner or edge of its box. Drawn by the engine (so it's in video, PNG and PDF too); empty text hides it, and a card whose text changes between states morphs.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `at` | enum | `"auto"` | Where the card sits in its box — or an expression over signals, for a card that moves between states. With `dodge`, `auto` (and any anchor, as a first choice) moves it to where it covers the least data and text. |
| `dodge` | bool | `true` | Move out of the way of data and text (taking a band below the chart when nowhere is free). Off: the card stays at `at` (`auto`: top-right), over whatever is there — a card over a map, where land covers everything. |
| `kicker` | prop |  | A small accent line above the title (empty: no line). |
| `margin` | number | `12` | Space between the card and its box's edges (px, or [top, right, bottom, left]). |
| `text` | prop |  | The body text (a string, or an expression over signals: one card narrating every state). |
| `title` | prop |  | A bold line above the text (empty: no line). |
| `width` | number | `260` | Card width (px); text wraps inside. |

Theme tokens: `card`, `card-ink`, `card-ink-2`, `card-line`, `radius.card`, `accent`, `size.body`, `size.small`

## cloud

`@datars/std/cloud` — A point cloud of any size (millions of rows): dots at their own x/y in an explorable view — a density-preserving sample at every zoom, every row up close, a tooltip on each.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bbox` | json |  | The extent to frame, [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the rows' units. Default: the rows' extent — give it for millions of rows (finding it reads them all) and for point archives. |
| `budget` | number | `2048` | Rows per tile of the index at average density (smaller: lighter tiles, more of them). |
| `children` | children | `[]` | Drawn over the dots, in the same coordinates (annotations, marks). |
| `data` | table |  | A table, or a point archive (a `tiles` source the publish compiler wrote). |
| `explore` | string | `"cloud"` | The signals the camera explores with (`<explore>.x`, `.y`, `.zoom`). |
| `fill` | prop |  | Dot ink, or an expression over the row (default $mark). |
| `glow` | prop |  | Radius (px) of a glow under the dots (a number or an expression over the row): a sample drawn large and faint, so density reads at a glance and, up close, stars bloom. None by default. |
| `glowOpacity` | prop |  | The glow's opacity per dot: a number (default 0.05) or an expression over the row (weight bright rows). |

| `label` | prop |  | Tooltip and accessible name per row (default `x, y`). |
| `maxZoom` | number | `2048` | How far in the reader can zoom, × the whole. |

## connectedScatter

| `link` | enum | `"curve"` | Links as smooth curves, right-angled elbows or straight lines. |

## violin

`@datars/std/violin` — A violin per category: the values' kernel density (Gaussian, Silverman's bandwidth unless given) mirrored around the category's centre, over the range of the data — its shape shows where values bunch, where a box plot shows five numbers. A bar marks the middle half and a dot the median. Horizontal when y is the band axis.

| param | type | default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bandwidth` | number | `0` | Kernel bandwidth in value units (0: Silverman's rule, per category). Smaller follows the data more closely; larger smooths. |
| `color` | field |  | Field on the colour scale (inside a plot: its colour). |
| `data` | table |  | One row per observation. |
| `fill` | prop |  | Ink (default: the colour scale, else $mark). |
| `format` | string | `",.1~f"` | Number format in tooltips. |
| `normalize` | enum | `"area"` | `area`: every violin encloses the same area, so a narrow spread is tall and wide; `width`: every violin is as wide as the band at its peak. |
| `opacity` | number | `0.85` | Fill opacity. |
| `quartiles` | bool | `true` | A bar over the middle half and a dot at the median. |
| `steps` | number | `80` | Points along each outline. |
| `width` | number | `0.9` | The widest violin's width as a fraction of the band. |
| `x` | field |  | Field on the x axis (inside a plot: its x). |
| `xType` | string | `"band"` | The x scale's type (the plot passes it): `band`/`point` for categories, `linear`, `time`, … |
| `y` | field |  | Field on the y axis (inside a plot: its y). |
| `yType` | string | `"linear"` | The y scale's type (the plot passes it); a band y lays the chart on its side. |

Theme tokens: `mark`, `ink`, `paper`

| `format` | string | `",.0f"` | Volume format in labels. |
| `opacity` | number | `0.55` | Bar opacity (volume recedes behind price). |
| `open` | string | `"open"` | Opening price field (for the colour). |
| `up` | ink | `"$up"` | Ink on rising days. |
| `volume` | string | `"volume"` | Volume field. |
| `width` | number | `0` | Bar width: a fraction of the band (0 = the band), px on a continuous scale. |
| `x` | field |  | The date field. |
| `xType` | string | `"band"` | `band`: trading days side by side, no weekend gaps (the plot's); `time`/`linear`: rows by value. |
| `y` | field |  | The plot's value field: the close, unless `close` is given. |
| `yScale` | string | `"lower"` | The value scale: `lower` (the plot's lower pane), or `y` for a volume chart of its own. |
